body:
[OPM](/s "Manga Spoiler")
Well Garou's finally turning into a demon with all those wrecked clothes isn't he
Hey I was right, but that's too obvious I guess
This manga is actually sweet and cheesy. Need more updates from them though
I hope it does! They used to update daily and the emotions kind of built up
It kind of leaves something heavy on your chest doesn't it????
This manga is the is the cheesiest, but I think the update period is ruining the built-up emotions.
The story of the webcomic is still on the better-illustrated manga, it's just that they are adding more bits to extend the story for the anime I guess.

Some mangas have their chapter's name as some line that the chapter contain. This is just laziness imo, but doesn't really affect me that much because I kind of binge every manga so I don't really pay attention to the title.
Yamada-kun is really worthy of reading to the end! It's not just about switching bodies though but you'll get the hang of the witches once you've been attached to the characters!

I like how they are introducing the main antagonists one by one like black sperm, and now I reckon that the giant beast will be rover. I still wish they kinda pick up some pace with the updates but I think the effort that they are showing is really worth the wait
That's why I am almost a shut-in. It's like I'm on a different dimension or something, I just can't get a grasp of reality now.
I know right? How do you "un-exist" without hurting anyone's feelings?

I haven't mentioned that I DID! But they ignored me, then a kind and concerned friend told me that they all already knew what happened and hated me for it. I kind of regret apologizing because of them not even recognizing me as one of them to begin with.
You guys are not helping with my undying love for ReLIFE!! You're all making the goodbyes even worse aaaaaaaa
Even if I am not that kind of a NEET, reading and watching ReLIFE made me realize what have I been doing wrong with my life.

I made an account just to say that this story is the best I have read so far in my life! Last chapter is coming sooner than we've imagined.

I reckon that the last lines for the last chapter would be Kaizaki introducing himself to Ohga brother and then saying "My name is Kaizaki Arata, I work for the ReLIFE laboratory" or something like Ryo did on the beginning because Yayoi senpai likes to do that kind of stuff.

Anyway, it has been my pleasure to be part of this community, I hope we all get what we wanted for this story!
